+  %1 = call <8 x i32> @llvm.experimental.vector.insert.v8i32.v4i32(<8 x i32> %vec, <4 x i32> %subvec, i64 2)
+  ret <8 x i32> %1

The lowering logic now distinguishes signed vs. unsigned saturating opcodes and maps them to different ARMISD nodes, while the target constructor marks unsigned saturating ops as custom for i8 and i16.
Changed symbols: ARMTargetLowering::LowerOperation; ARMTargetLowering::ReplaceNodeResults; ARMTargetLowering::ARMTargetLowering; LowerSADDSUBSAT; ARMISD::UQADD8b; ARMISD::UQSUB8b; ARMISD::UQADD16b; ARMISD::UQSUB16b
Behavioral change: Unsigned saturating add/subtract are now custom-lowered instead of being handled by the signed saturating lowering path.; The lowering helper selects distinct unsigned ARM opcodes rather than reusing signed QADD/QSUB opcodes.; New instruction selection patterns allow these unsigned saturating nodes to match ARM and Thumb2 machine instructions.
